points.description: States that leg bones are large because they carry/support a lot of weight (the body's weight). Equivalent wording accepted, e.g. 'support the body's mass', 'bear most of the load', 'hold up the whole body'. Do not accept answers about movement/walking alone, or vague 'they are long/important' with no mention of weight or support.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that leg bones are large because they support or carry the body's weight. No marks for answers that give only movement, length or importance with no reference to weight or load.
